text_block_list.text:
During a meeting on Christmas Day,
I noticed the snow had begun to pile up.

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text: Ah... Snow...!

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text:
Yes.
My hometown gets a lot of snow, so it brings back fond memories.

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text: Besides... the snow absorbs sound.
choice_data_list: Want to step outside and take a look?

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text:
Fufu, the air is so clear here, just as I thought.
It brings back memories...

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text: Running in the snow feels so comforting.
choice_data_list: You used to run a lot, didn't you?

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text:
Yes. If I recall correctly...
I think snow was what made me fall in love with running, too.
choice_data_list: (The reason she started running in the first place...!)

text_block_list.text: "Tell me more about that." When I asked her, she began to speak, bit by bit.

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text:
—When I was a child, drawn out by the quiet outside air,
I once tried running across the snowy fields.

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text:
Gradually, the only thing I could hear was my own heartbeat.
It was so quiet, so pure white, so beautiful... It was breathtaking.

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text:
"It felt like... I had the entire world
all to myself..."

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text:
Come to think of it, ever since then,
I feel like I've been obsessed with running.
—Umamusume run for many different reasons, but having a reason like hers is surely rare.

"However,
her dedication to that 'scenery' is the real deal."
choice_data_list: Let's have the whole world to ourselves until you're satisfied.

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text: "Together"...

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text:
Fufu, yes, you're right.
Let's do that...!

—After that, the two of us decided
to take a walk in the snow for a while.

As she stared intently at the snow,
I asked her what was on her mind—

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text:
Snow means...
it's going to be a White Christmas, right...?

When I answered, she fell into thought again,
busily gathering up more snow.

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text:
Fufu, since it's a
"White Christmas" after all.

Where she had been crouching down,
an adorable snow bunny had been brought to life.

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text: I used to make it from time to time in the past.

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text:
It isn't anything grand, but...
Well, consider it a gift.

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text:
...Merry Christmas,
Trainer.

—And so, I was able to spend
an unforgettable Christmas with Silence Suzuka.

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text: Fufu...

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text:
No... it's just, somehow, that tree stump
started looking like a Bûche de Noël to me.

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text:
Still... so it's Christmas, is it?
I hadn't been paying attention.

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text:
Um... since we're here,
would you like to have some cake?

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text: Maybe a Bûche de Noël, or something.

—After buying sponge cake and decorations,
we decided to make a cake in the Trainer's room.

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text:
...Is the cream fine like this?
Does it look like a tree stump?

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text: Fufu, that's a relief.

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text:
Trainer... hehe,
you put way too many strawberries on there.

—And so, I was able to spend
an unforgettable Christmas with Silence Suzuka.
